content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating-5|payment]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]]-guide-kyc-payment-gateways-digital-sellers-2|The Full]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is building on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Ebooks online

Rented platforms like Gumroad or Paddle offer convenience until they don’t. You get a dashboard, payment processing, and file delivery—all tied to their terms. Sovereign infrastructure, built with tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, gives you ownership. No dashboard. No platform lock-in. Your stack runs on open protocols. You control hosting, logic, storage, and delivery. The tradeoff? Convenience versus permanence. Platforms rent you access. Infrastructure gives you architecture.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries. PayPal suspends accounts in restricted regions, holding funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow these payment rails. If Stripe or PayPal isn’t available, neither are they. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase for storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. No country restrictions. No platform gatekeepers. Your stack operates on infrastructure available everywhere.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Platforms rent you access. Infrastructure gives you ownership.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choose rented platforms if you’re in a supported country and value convenience over control. Choose sovereign infrastructure if you’re in a restricted region or want permanent ownership. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours. Five products loaded. SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured. End-to-end tested. You own the stack. No platform can lock you out. Architecture wins over convenience every time.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe isn’t available in your country, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the permanent solution. It uses open tools like Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments to bypass platform restrictions. You host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, store orders in Supabase, and accept crypto payments with NOWPayments. No country restrictions. No platform gatekeepers. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, giving you full ownership and control.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—no KYC, no buyer accounts.

Load your products and test end-to-end. 7. Deploy and own your infrastructure. No platforms. No restrictions.
